integrity.metadataNormalization: Preflight stopped before any case; exact original manifest preserved; identical corpus digest alias added. No runtime/corpus/output retuning or discarded first-case result.

qualityDefinitions.BEST_SUPPORTED: Best-supported covered decision against actual supplied goal/context and alternatives; does not imply broad physiological or whole-program optimum.
qualityDefinitions.ACCEPTABLE_ALTERNATIVE: Reasonable goal-compatible output without proof it wins against all material alternatives.
qualityDefinitions.SUBOPTIMAL: A material better-supported decision or unresolved trade-off is omitted; admissibility does not repair the quality defect.
qualityDefinitions.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Genuine missing facts or invalid represented observation chronology prevents judging the intended coaching. Correct ASK/HOLD is distinguished from positive prescription.
qualityDefinitions.UNSUPPORTED: Requested task is unserved or intentionally outside frozen contract/domain. This label does not by itself mean an unsafe positive output; see category/routing/subdecisions.

generationStages.note: These are intermediate outputs for REVIEW/SEQUENCE cases, not24additional tasks or necessarily complete goal-ready programs.

unsupportedPositivePrescriptions.limit: No unsafe/unsupported physical prescription identified in these19positive stages. Three generation stages are nevertheless SUBOPTIMAL for Balanced decision quality. This is not evidence of zero risk outside the observed cases.

insufficientChange.reason: Known supplied hotel substitutions are not evaluated; requested useful adaptation is unserved.

adaptationMetrics.limit: The two MODIFY outputs do not establish progression, regression, whole-block adaptation or return breadth.

validAthleteSpecificUpdate.meaning: Each stores one complete comparable actual observation and retains the prior; no hard trait or earned dose is inferred.

learnedFutureRankingEffect.reason: Rich-history and arrangement cases do not reach the intended learner/ranking path; sequence progression is blocked by chronology or input contract.

ignoredRelevantHistory.reason: Critical source/contract/generation rejection precedes the intended matched-history comparison.

overfit.reason: No fresh holdout learned dose or schedule decision reaches a usable longitudinal comparison.

falseCausality.reason: No causal athlete trait or physiological gain is claimed in the observed outputs; this is not a validated zero-false-causality rate.

limitations: Offline synthetic inputs and outcomes only; no human/clinical/empirical or production validation.
Best-supported KEEP decisions and correct ASK/clinical routing are not counted as newly prescribed programs.
Material positive generation defects propagate to primaryH11/H20 even where the later HOLD/MOVE is separately appropriate.
No arbitrary percentage threshold or score is used to obtain READY.
